resources.string: EyeGaze estimates where you look from the front camera. Frames are processed on this device only; the app has no network access.
Export a trained run with `eyegaze export --run runs/base --out models/base`, then build with -Peyegaze.bundle=models/base.\n\nDetails: %1$s
Face not visible — hold the phone at arm\'s length, face lit from the front.
Look at a cell, then close both eyes for about half a second to select it. Long-press for diagnostics.
